headline: Tariff refund lifts margins as sales soften; guidance raised
summary_short: Net sales fell 3% y/y to $1.99B while operating profit rose 14% to $470M and diluted EPS grew 25% to $1.60, aided by a $95M net benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds recognized in the quarter.
summary_long: Second-quarter net sales declined 3% y/y to $1.99B as Plumbing Products fell 3% and Decorative Architectural Products fell 4%; North America dropped 5% in local currency, partly offset by 4% International growth. Gross margin expanded 600bp to 43.6% and operating margin rose 350bp to 23.6%, largely reflecting a $95M net benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds. Diluted EPS rose 25% to $1.60 ($1.64 adjusted, +26%), aided by a lower diluted share count (199M vs 211M) from buybacks. Masco returned $454M to shareholders via dividends and repurchases; liquidity stood at $1.55B. Management raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $4.40-$4.60 (from $4.10-$4.30) on an expected $85M full-year tariff-refund benefit; reported EPS guidance is $4.21-$4.41.

drivers.explanation: Plumbing Products fell 3% and Decorative Architectural Products fell 4%; in local currency North American sales decreased 5%, partly offset by 4% growth in International, against a "challenging comparison to the prior year."
Adjusted operating profit grew 17%, primarily reflecting a "net benefit of approximately $95 million from IEEPA tariff refunds" recognized this quarter, per the CEO's remarks.
Tracks the operating-profit gain from the tariff-refund benefit; income tax expense rose to $107M from $95M but was outpaced by the $62M increase in pre-tax income.
EPS growth (25%) outpaced net-income growth (18%) because diluted weighted-average shares fell to 199M from 211M, reflecting this quarter's share repurchases.

CEO Jon Nudi cited strong H1 execution and brand strength, but called Q2 sales results a "challenging comparison" plus targeted growth investment; the ~$95M IEEPA tariff-refund benefit drove adjusted profit and EPS growth and prompted a raise to full-year adjusted EPS guidance.
